messages.author: e616e19cf68e4d4a
messages.subject: ordering data
parts:
Hello Everyone,

I want to order my data on the bar plot y axis according to how it is
ordered in the df$Group: c,b,d,a

I am probably overlooking something simple; I must be.

thanks,

Josh


df=data.frame(Group=rep(letters[c(3,2,4,1)],each=2),Exposure=rnorm(8,mean=5,sd=2),Var=rep(c("high","low"),
8),stringsAsFactors=F);df;str(df)
qplot(Group,Exposure,data=df,fill=Var,geom="bar",position="dodge")
+coord_flip()+theme_bw()
